data.description:
## Problem
rebar MCP is configured globally per machine for all 3 harnesses, so every codex/claude/copilot session on the host gets it, and codex startup failed (2026-09-09) with a not-logged-in error when a GUI-launched process lacked MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX (valid PAT; 401 rendered as not-logged-in). Operator ruling: scope rebar MCP to this project via harness-native project mechanisms; claude+copilot consolidate onto one PAT var.

## Plan (tracked-file half; machine-local half already applied)
1. Add .mcp.json at repo root: rebar server entry, type http, url https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp, header Authorization: Bearer ${MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI}. Read by Claude Code (project scope) AND Copilot CLI >=1.0.83 (workspace config; verified it loads .mcp.json first-found over .github/mcp.json and overrides user-level entries).
2. Add [mcp_servers.rebar] to tracked .codex/config.toml: url + bearer_token_env_var = "MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX" + startup_timeout_sec = 120 (carry the cold-start comment from the user-level config).
3. Update infra/runbooks/mcp-client-pats.md: document MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI (claude slot shared by Claude Code + Copilot CLI; codex keeps its own), the launchd-env publishing step (GUI launches do not source ~/.zshenv), and the project-scope files.
4. If mcp-clients.local.example.json or docs/mcp-client-setup.md reference the old per-client global wiring, update the affected lines.

## Acceptance criteria
- .mcp.json and .codex/config.toml rebar entries exist with env-var refs only (no secrets committed).
- Runbook documents the CLI-PAT consolidation and launchd publishing.
- make verify green.

## File impact
.mcp.json, .codex/config.toml, infra/runbooks/mcp-client-pats.md, docs/mcp-client-setup.md (maybe), mcp-clients.local.example.json (maybe)
data.title: Project-scope rebar MCP client config (codex/claude/copilot)
